prompt: Repair a rendered dashboard with keyboard traps, weak focus, a dynamic error, a 400% zoom overflow, and a contrast failure. Preserve the product's visual direction and verify fixes with browser evidence.
assertions: Findings converge on the same WCAG criterion, path, and severity across runs.
Fixes include measured contrast/zoom evidence, keyboard traversal, names, and dynamic announcement behavior.
Automated audit is supplemented with a real browser path.
Every finding has status, reason, remediation, evidence, and provenance; bare checkmarks and n/a without a subject-absence reason are rejected.
The skill's one authoritative self-check is used; three runs may vary structure, aesthetic, and voice but preserve the same repair truth.

run_protocol.material_difference_requirement: Accept diversity only when each compared run cites at least two material changes across the declared axes and ties each change to the prompt or evidence; a new order, synonym, recolor, or unsupported style swap is not diversity.
run_protocol.negative_routing_requirement: The negative neighbor (cognitive-a11y) must be explicitly rejected with a reason and handoff boundary.
